raw: ok so i've been thinking about this a lot. most of the guys i work with they think they have a discipline problem. like they cant wake up early or stick to the gym or whatever. but thats not actually it. the real thing is they dont have clarity. they dont know what they actually want so they just kind of float and then beat themselves up for not being disciplined. discipline is easy when you know why. so before we fix the discipline we have to fix the clarity. thats the whole thing.
ideal: Most of the guys I work with think they have a discipline problem. They can't wake up early. Can't stick to the gym. So they grind on willpower and beat themselves up when it slips. But it was never discipline. It's clarity. When you don't know what you actually want, you float. Discipline is easy when you know why. So we don't fix the discipline first. We fix the clarity. That's the whole thing.
